title: Our CI fails randomly about once a day
excerpt: Our CI fails randomly about once a day and engineers just press re-run. Nobody owns the flaky tests, so they pile up for months.

title: Waiting 40 minutes for the CI queue
excerpt: Waiting 40 minutes for the CI queue before a two-line change can merge is killing our velocity. We tried bigger runners but costs doubled.

title: Quarantining flaky tests by hand
excerpt: Quarantining flaky tests by hand takes our platform team several hours every week. The existing dashboards show failures but not causes.
